generator: G = Hc + theta_K * FKhat + theta_M * Mhat

plain_ladder.bootstrap: one previous-depth energy-selected vector; knots x_l=(l-0.5)/L; linear if source has fewer than 3 knots, natural cubic otherwise; constant endpoint clamp; copy gamma and theta; no extra perturb

templates.shell_aggregate: pointwise mean on target knots after gauge alignment
templates.scalar_aggregate: componentwise median of gauge-aligned gamma, theta_K, theta_M; numpy median (even count averages the two central values)
templates.starts: 1 unperturbed center + 12 perturbations sigma=0.02 + 12 perturbations sigma=0.1, i.i.d. normal on the full legal vector

gauge.rule: If gamma < -gamma0, replace (gamma, shell) by (-gamma, -shell) before aggregation. Unwrap each shell coefficient by the verified period relative to the latest training source resampled onto that source's knots. Latest source is the deepest training depth after the same gamma rule.
gauge.period_probe: Fixed SeedSequence 711080, L=3, not a training outcome. For each of c1,c2,c3, use pi/2 if overlap with the unshifted state is >= 1-1e-8, else pi if that passes, else do not unwrap that coefficient.
gauge.training_vector_check: Aligned parameters must stay on the original ray, or the conjugate ray if gamma was flipped, with overlap >= 1-1e-8. If shell unwrapping breaks the ray, drop unwrapping for that vector and record it. If the gamma flip itself breaks the ray, keep the original vector.

screen.definition: A finished start succeeds when its energy is <= screen_energy[L] + 1e-8.
screen.screen_energy_source: round4_V qaoa_fresh energy at p=ceil((3L+3)/2): p=9 at L5, p=11 at L6. Commit 5ebca82a, summary.json.
screen.evals_in_ratio: marginal nfev at that depth and arm, including preregistered top-up. Shared ladder prefix is not in the ratio.
screen.sample_for_screen: equalized sample if top-up finishes; otherwise the preregistered sample and the equal-budget screen is censored

basin_posthoc.definition: energy <= stored replay energy + 1e-6. Scoring only. These energies are not training targets and are not passed to the optimizer.

dominance: Same energy-selected state improves a baseline only when baseline_E - E > 1e-8 and F - baseline_F > 1e-8. Rounded labels 0.292 and 0.610 are not used.

cost.predicting_L5_twice: plain L5 and template L5 are both stored. Plain L5 is not an input to template L5.
cost.template_L6_source: preregistered plain L5 energy-selected vector, not a later top-up and not template L5
cost.topup: After both predictions and plain L6, add starts to the arm with smaller marginal nfev at that depth until marginal nfev matches or 48 extra starts or fewer than 10 minutes remain. Plain top-up uses the plain random box. Template top-up uses sigma 0.1 about the template center. Top-up does not replace vectors already used as training sources.
cost.qaoa_floor: round4_V p9-p12 nfev is the same-hash floor. New QAOA starts run only if this run's total nfev exceeds that floor at the compared depth. Otherwise record the floor as already larger.
